notes.title: Patch 1.17 has been released for ELDEN RING. This patch aims to bring support the Tarnished Pack DLC, scheduled for release on Friday, August 28, 2026, and to implement gameplay balance adjustments.

items.text: Please apply the latest update before playing.
The following elements will be added upon purchase of the "Tarnished Pack" DLC.
Added Idus Knight and Heavy Knight as new starting classes, selectable during character creation.
Note: The equipment of each new starting class can also be obtained by purchasing it from merchants in the Lands Between or by finding it in the world.
Added weapons that can be purchased from merchants or found in the Lands Between.
Added three types of Spectral Steed Attire that change the appearance of Torrent:
Tree Sentinel Spectral Steed Attire: Found in Stormveil Castle.
Silver of Caria Spectral Steed Attire: Found in Liurnia of the Lakes.

An update for the Steam client has been released which should prevent the issue of conflicting local and cloud save data described below. Please update your Steam client to the latest version.
In the PC version of ELDEN RING, save data is not being saved correctly to the Steam Cloud under certain conditions.

When starting up the game, the following error message appears: 'Your local ELDEN RING files conflict with the ones stored in the Steam Cloud.' Check the date and time of each save, then select the saved data you want to keep and complete the synchronization.
Note: If you play Elden Ring on only one computer, you almost certainly want to choose Local Files.

notes.title: To load the save file from the Cloud

items.text: Select “Download to this machine” to the right of “Cloud Files.”

notes.title: To load your local save file

items.text: Select “Upload to the STEAM Cloud” to the right of “Local files.”
*The "Cloud Files" are saved data uploaded from your local machine at the time and date indicated in the "Last modified" section.

RECOMMENDATION: It is recommended that you back up your local save data elsewhere, in case you unintentionally overwrite your computer's local save data with old save data left in the cloud, e.g. due to an operational error. Click here to learn more about saving saved data.
We apologies for any inconvenience this may cause for you and thank you in advance for your patience.

items.text: Start-up issues related to Easy Anti Cheat (EAC) have been improved.
Mouse operation improved.
Reduced number of files needed to load when entering a new area.

The team is continuing to work on improvements to the game based on your feedback. If you need official support for an issue you have encountered in ELDEN RING, please contact the Bandai Namco Support Teams (Europe | America)

notes.title: Patch notes for Elden Ring version 1.02 are available now.

items.text: We have started distributing a patch to improve the stability of the gameplay. We apologize for the inconvenience, but please apply the latest patch before playing the game.
When this patch is applied, the version on the bottom right of the title screen will read as follows:
App Ver. 1.02
Regulation Ver. 1.02.1

notes.title: Major items included in the latest update

items.text: Improved player controls
Addition and adjustment of BGM
Text adjustments
Balance adjustments
NPC event fixes and adjustments
Fixed frame rate drops under certain conditions
Fixed text bug in some languages
*Timing for the implementation of ray tracing, which is planned to be supported after the launch, will be revealed in future announcements.
Please apply the patch after downloading the full game.

This patch is also available in the Digital Art Book & Soundtrack included in the Digital Deluxe Edition. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, but please apply the update file to this as well before starting the game.
Thank you for your cooperation.
